home.values.title: What we're about
home.values.social.title: Social first
home.values.social.body: We care about good company as much as good loot. It doesn't matter if you're new to the game or you've played for years.
home.values.raiding.title: Casual raiding
home.values.raiding.body: We raid together, but we don't chase parses or logs. Real life always comes first.
home.values.nordic.title: Where we're from
home.values.nordic.body: Most of us are from Sweden, Norway and Denmark. English speakers are welcome too.
home.closing.title: Interested?
home.closing.body: Applying is simple. Post a short introduction about yourself in our Discord.
about.hero.title: About Eldvik
about.story.body: Eldvik is a Nordic guild for World of Warcraft: Forever. We're adults from Sweden, Norway and Denmark who believe the journey matters more than the destination, that dungeons are better with people you like, and that nobody should feel dumb for asking a question. We raid, but we don't chase logs. Real life always comes first.
about.name.title: The name
about.name.body: Eld means fire. Vik means bay, or cove. That's where Eldvik comes from.
about.values.title: What we value
about.values.item1.title: Respect
about.values.item1.body: You'll be treated with respect from day one, whatever you play and however experienced you are.
about.values.item2.title: Show up when you can
about.values.item2.body: Life comes first. Log in when you're able. Nobody needs to be online every night.
about.values.item3.title: Ask anything
about.values.item3.body: There's no such thing as a stupid question here. We were all new once.
about.values.item4.title: No drama
about.values.item4.body: No logs, no parses, no elitism. Just people enjoying a game together.
about.closing.title: Want to know more?
about.closing.body: Take a look at recruitment, or go straight to our Discord to apply.
recruitment.hero.title: Recruitment
recruitment.hero.lead: All classes and roles are welcome at Eldvik. We're social-first: adults from Sweden, Norway and Denmark — English speakers welcome too — with no experience requirements. No logs, no parses, just good company and a willingness to show up.
recruitment.looking.title: What we're looking for
recruitment.looking.item1.title: Any class, any role
recruitment.looking.item1.body: We're not short on anything in particular. Play what you like — tank, healer or damage.
recruitment.looking.item2.title: Adults, Nordic friendly
recruitment.looking.item2.body: Adult players from Sweden, Norway and Denmark. English speakers are just as welcome.
recruitment.looking.item3.title: No experience needed
recruitment.looking.item3.body: New to raiding, or coming back after a break? That's fine. We don't check logs or ask about experience.
recruitment.schedule.title: How raiding will work
recruitment.schedule.body: Raid nights will be announced closer to launch — expect two evenings a week, European time, so weeknights work alongside jobs, studies and families.
recruitment.closing.title: How to apply
recruitment.closing.body: The Join page walks through it, or you can go straight to our Discord.
join.hero.title: Join Eldvik
join.hero.lead: Applying takes a few minutes. Here's how it works.
join.step1.title: Join our Discord
join.step1.body: This is where we talk, plan raids and hang out. Most of the guild is there most days.
join.step2.title: Go to #apply-to-eldvik
join.step2.body: Start a new post in the #apply-to-eldvik forum channel. It doesn't need to be long.
join.step3.title: Post a short introduction
join.step3.body: Say where you're from, what you like to play, and anything else you want us to know. An officer will reply.
join.reassurance: It doesn't have to be long. A few sentences is enough.
join.launchNote: Realm and raid schedule will be announced as launch (November 4, 2026) gets closer — join the Discord now to be part of the planning.
